rows.expectation: NONZERO, and it is the KERNEL that is being measured, not weight location. This comparison varies two things at once — where the expert lives AND which GEMM computes it (grouped 4-bit over a gathered slot store vs per-expert GEMV). It was originally written as the tier-transition row; it cannot test that claim. With the kernel held fixed (reference moved onto the engine at hot_set=ALL) location alone measures exactly 0.000 — see granite-hot.json. Retained because the kernel cost is a real, separately useful number.
